# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。
- **双向绑定**: [two-way-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/two-way-binding.md) - wx:model 语法。
- **引用 (Refs)**: [refs.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/refs.md)

## 6. 其他
- **生命周期**: [lifecycle.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/lifecycle.md)

<template>
  <view class="publish-page">
    <view class="publish-header">
      <text class="publish-title">发布社区动态</text>
      <text class="publish-tip">分享真实体验，帮助更多邻居</text>
    </view>

    <view class="form-card">
      <textarea
        class="content-input"
        maxlength="500"
        placeholder="说说商品体验、社区活动或闲置好物..."
        value="{{content}}"
        bindinput="updateContent"
      />
      <text class="word-count">{{content.length}} / 500</text>

      <view class="photo-grid">
        <view class="photo-item" wx:for="{{photos}}" wx:key="tempFilePath">
          <image class="photo-image" src="{{item.tempFilePath}}" mode="aspectFill" />
          <view class="photo-remove" catchtap="removePhoto(index)" aria-role="button" aria-label="删除图片">
            <text>×</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view
          wx:if="{{photos.length < 9}}"
          class="photo-add"
          bindtap="choosePhoto"
          aria-role="button"
          aria-label="添加图片"
        >
          <text class="photo-add-icon">+</text>
          <text class="photo-add-label">添加图片</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="publish-options">
      <view class="option-row" bindtap="choosePlace">
        <view class="option-main">
          <text class="option-icon">⌖</text>
          <view class="option-copy">
            <text class="option-label">所在位置</text>
            <text class="option-value">{{place.name || '选择位置'}}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <text class="option-arrow">›</text>
      </view>

      <view wx:if="{{place.name}}" class="place-card" bindtap="openPlace">
        <view class="place-copy">
          <text class="place-name">{{place.name}}</text>
          <text class="place-address">{{place.address}}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="place-action">查看地图</text>
      </view>

      <view class="option-row">
        <view class="option-main">
          <text class="option-icon">#</text>
          <view class="option-copy">
            <text class="option-label">社区话题</text>
            <picker mode="selector" range="{{topics}}" range-key="name" bindchange="selectTopic">
              <text class="option-value">{{selectedTopic.name || '选择话题'}}</text>
            </picker>
          </view>
        </view>
        <text class="option-arrow">›</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="publish-notice">
      <switch checked="{{allowComments}}" bindchange="toggleComments" color="#1677ff" />
      <text class="notice-text">允许其他用户评论</text>
    </view>

    <button
      class="publish-button"
      loading="{{submitting}}"
      disabled="{{!canSubmit || submitting}}"
      bindtap="submitPost"
    >
      发布动态
    </button>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    content: '',
    photos: [],
    place: {},
    topics: [
      { id: 'shopping', name: '社区好物' },
      { id: 'activity', name: '邻里活动' },
      { id: 'secondhand', name: '闲置交换' },
      { id: 'service', name: '便民服务' }
    ],
    selectedTopic: {},
    allowComments: true,
    submitting: false
  },
  computed: {
    canSubmit () {
      return Boolean(this.content.trim() || this.photos.length)
    }
  },
  methods: {
    updateContent (event) {
      this.content = event.detail.value
    },
    choosePlace () {
      wx.chooseLocation({
        success: (place) => {
          this.place = place
        }
      })
    },
    openPlace () {
      if (!this.place.latitude || !this.place.longitude) return
      wx.openLocation({
        latitude: this.place.latitude,
        longitude: this.place.longitude,
        name: this.place.name,
        address: this.place.address
      })
    },
    choosePhoto () {
      wx.chooseMedia({
        count: 9 - this.photos.length,
        mediaType: ['image'],
        sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
        success: ({ tempFiles }) => {
          this.photos = this.photos.concat(tempFiles)
        }
      })
    },
    removePhoto (index) {
      this.photos.splice(index, 1)
    },
    selectTopic (event) {
      this.selectedTopic = this.topics[Number(event.detail.value)]
    },
    toggleComments (event) {
      this.allowComments = event.detail.value
    },
    submitPost () {
      if (!this.canSubmit || this.submitting) return
      this.submitting = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/community/posts',
        method: 'POST',
        data: {
          content: this.content,
          photos: this.photos.map(item => item.tempFilePath),
          place: this.place,
          topicId: this.selectedTopic.id || '',
          allowComments: this.allowComments
        },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          wx.redirectTo({ url: `/pages/community/detail?id=${data.id}` })
        },
        fail: () => {
          wx.showToast({ title: '发布失败，请重试', icon: 'none' })
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.submitting = false
        }
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>
